# Repository-specific privacy sweep patterns for openai2otel: OpenAI credential and identifier shapes.
# Same syntax rules as identifier-patterns.txt. The minimum lengths keep these from matching prose
# that names the shape (for example "org-" or "proj_" on their own).

# OpenAI keys (sk-proj- is already in the default set).
sk-admi[n]-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}
sk-svcacc[t]-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}

# OpenAI organisation, project, user and key ids.
or[g]-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}
pro[j]_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}
use[r]-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}
ke[y]_[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}
